question: Given a VCF file containing somatic mutations from whole-exome sequencing, normalize the variants and calculate the Tumor Mutational Burden (TMB) in mutations per megabase.

expected_output.guidelines: Normalized variant records must match the reference in CHROM, POS, REF, and ALT; header lines and INFO-field order may differ.
Value must be a single numeric value matching the reference within 1% relative absolute error.
